Fit detailed TOP models for selected follow-up variants

Source: R/top_followup.R
top_followup.Rd

Fits one TOP model per selected variant and returns variant-specific global tests and second-stage effect estimates. This is intended for the limited set of variants selected after a score scan, not for genome-wide fitting.

Usage

top_followup(
  y,
  variants,
  adjustment = NULL,
  variant_structure = c("additive", "baseline", "pairwise", "saturated"),
  missing_value = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  subtype_cutoff = 10,
  on_error = c("record", "stop"),
  keep_models = TRUE
)

Arguments

y

Numeric outcome matrix as described in [top_fit()].

variants

Numeric vector, matrix, or data frame with selected variants in columns.

adjustment

Optional numeric adjustment covariates. These use the additive second-stage structure.

variant_structure

Second-stage structure for each tested variant.

missing_value

Numeric missing-tumor code for cases, or `NULL`.

start

Optional starting vector passed to [top_fit()].

subtype_cutoff

Subtypes with counts at or below this value are omitted.

on_error

Whether a failed fit should be recorded or stop the run.

keep_models

Keep the fitted `top_model` objects in the result.

Value

A `top_followup` object with global tests, effect estimates, optional fitted models, and recorded errors.
